name: micro
description: Modern terminal-based text editor with intuitive key bindings and plugin support

tools.description: Modern, intuitive terminal text editor with mouse support, syntax highlighting, and common key bindings
tools.usage:
micro file.txt # Edit file with familiar keybindings
micro -colorscheme monokai # Use specific color scheme
micro -plugin install filemanager # Install plugin
micro +10 file.txt # Jump to line 10
micro -config-dir /path # Custom config directory
